home.title: Ads
home.description: Create ads, submit them for review and track results.
home.pendingAccount: Your account is not verified yet. You can create an ad and submit it for review — payment opens once it is approved.

campaigns.emptyDescription: Create your first ad in 4 steps: placement, schedule, banner — then submit it for review.

toasts.paymentClaimed: Message sent — the ad goes live once the payment is confirmed

nextAction.submit: Not ready yet — finish the setup and submit for review
nextAction.verifying: Payment is being verified — the ad goes live once confirmed

pay.title: Pay for ad
pay.step1Title: Transfer the amount to the card
pay.step1Text: Use any banking app, Payme or Click to transfer exactly this amount.
pay.step2Text: Send a screenshot of the receipt — ad details are added to the message automatically.
pay.step3Text: An admin checks the transfer and confirms it. The ad then goes live automatically on its start day.
pay.claimedText: The ad goes live automatically once the transfer is confirmed. If you haven't sent the receipt yet, message us on Telegram.
pay.unavailable: Payment details aren't configured yet. Please contact us on Telegram.
pay.hint: The payment page opens in a new window. The ad goes live automatically once payment is confirmed.
pay.contactText: An admin will send you the payment details. The ad name, amount and ID are added to the message automatically.
pay.receiptText: Transfer exactly this amount and send a screenshot of the receipt to the same chat.
pay.waitingText: Complete the payment in the window that opened. This window updates itself as soon as the payment arrives.
pay.blockedText: Your browser blocked the new window. Open the payment page with the button below.
pay.otherMethodWarning: If you've already paid, don't choose another method — you could be charged twice.
pay.expiredText: The payment link has expired. If you were charged, message us on Telegram; otherwise try again.
pay.paidText: Your ad goes live automatically on its start day.
pay.startNowText: Goes live as soon as the payment clears.
pay.startLaterText: Goes live at the time you choose.
pay.startTimezone: Tashkent time. The run counts from this moment.
pay.startPast: That time has passed — pick a later one.

orders.title: Payments
orders.description: Payment history for all your ads.
orders.emptyDescription: Payments appear here once an ad is approved.

rateCard.title: Rate card
rateCard.description: Where your ad appears, how many people see it and what it costs.

register.title: Sign up as an advertiser
register.subtitle: Open an account to advertise to the MangaBox audience.
register.name: Brand or company name
register.passwordHint: Password must be at least {count} characters.

review.title: Moderation
review.text: The banner is checked against the rules

pay.title: Payment
pay.text: Card transfer, confirmed by an admin

place.title: Where should your ad appear?
place.text: Pick one or more placements. You'll set volume and price in the next step.

plan.title: How much and when?
plan.text: Choose a share for each placement, a start date and a duration. The price updates instantly.
plan.nameHint: Only for you. Leave empty to use “{name}”
plan.startLaterTitle: You'll pick the start time at payment
plan.startLaterText: After moderation, when you pay: right away or at a date and hour you choose. The run counts from the actual start, so no days are lost.

creative.title: Prepare your banner
creative.text: The text readers see, the link that opens on tap, and images. The preview on the right shows it in the app.
creative.bodyPlaceholder: A sentence or two: what you offer and why now.
creative.hrefHint: This page opens when someone taps the ad.
creative.postersText: The image is optional but gets more attention. Without one, a text banner is shown here.
creative.posterVideoSpec: GIF/video: at least {min} px, up to {max} MB, muted, loops up to 8 seconds
creative.videoTipTitle: You can also upload a video or GIF
creative.videoTipText: The lighter the file, the faster it opens for users and the less of their data it uses. Recommended: 3–6 seconds, under 2 MB, simple motion. Heavy files load slowly — until the video loads, users only see the still image.
creative.previewNote: How the selected placement looks on a phone. Each placement goes to moderation as its own banner.
creative.slotTabsHint: Each placement gets its own banner — text, logo and image can differ. Pick a placement and fill it in.
creative.applyAll: Apply this text to all placements
creative.slotPickerTitle: Which placement is this banner for?

review.title: Review and submit
review.text: If everything looks right, submit it. A submitted ad can't be changed.
nextSteps: A moderator checks each placement's banner against the rules.
Once approved, payment opens — via Payme, Click, Uzum, Paynet or card.
At payment you pick the start time: the ad goes live right away or at the time you set.
review.draftSaved: Draft saved — continue it from the list

locked.title: This ad has been submitted
locked.text: A submitted ad can't be changed. Track its status on the ad page.

moderation.blockedTitle: A moderator took some banners off air
moderation.pausedHelp: Fix the banners in the Banners tab based on the note and send them for another review. Once approved the ad resumes, and the paused days are added to its run.
moderation.blockedHelp: The campaign's other placements keep running. Fix the marked banners and send them for another review.
moderation.waiting: Fixes sent — a moderator is reviewing them.
moderation.blockedBadge: Taken off air by a moderator
moderation.fixHint: Fix the banners based on the moderator's note. Changes go live after the moderator approves them.

resumeChoice.title: Edit before resuming?
resumeChoice.description: You can resume the ad as it is, or change its banners first.
resumeChoice.editNote: If you change the banners, the ad goes back to moderation and returns to air once approved.
resumeChoice.endDate: The end date stays the same: {date}. Paused days are not added back.
resumeChoice.pendingNote: The banner in review goes on air once approved — until then the other banners are shown.

editMode.title: Editing mode
editMode.help: Change the banners in the Banners tab. If you change nothing, you can resume the ad right away.
editMode.helpEdited: Banners were changed — send them for review. The ad returns to air once approved.
editMode.endDate: End date: {date} — it does not change.
editMode.waiting: Sent for review — the ad returns to air once the moderator approves it.

renew.title: Run the ad again
renew.description: A new campaign is created with the same placements, {days} days and the same banners, at current prices.
renew.fast: If you keep the banners as they are, you go straight to payment and the ad airs right after it's paid.
renew.review: This ad was stopped by a moderator or has a blocked banner, so it goes through moderation again first.
renew.editNote: Want to change something? Edit it — it will go through moderation again.

bannerResume.title: Edit the banner before turning it on?
bannerResume.text: You can turn the "{slot}" banner on as it is, or edit it first.
bannerResume.editNote: If you change it, only this banner goes through moderation and airs once approved. The campaign's other banners stay on air.
bannerResume.endDate: The campaign end date does not change: {date}.
bannerResume.liveEditNote: If you save changes, this banner goes off air until a moderator approves it; the other banners stay on. The end date does not change: {date}.
bannerResume.reviewStrip: In review — goes on air once approved. Not shown in this placement until then.

airtime.pausedText: You paused it — it isn't shown anywhere right now. The period keeps running: the ad ends on {date}, and paused days are not added back.
airtime.pausedExpired: The period has ended — if you turn the ad on, it will finish. Use “Run again” to relaunch it.
airtime.reviewLive: The {slots} banner was edited and is in review. Until it's approved your ad isn't shown there; the other banners stay on air.
airtime.reviewPaused: The {slots} banner was edited and is in review. Even once approved, it won't air until you turn the ad back on.
